title: Use OIDC authentication reference solution

answer.approach: A complete response for use oidc authentication should include: id-token: write, permissions:, environment:.
answer.example:
jobs:
  deploy:
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    environment: staging
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Request cloud identity
        run: echo "Configure the provider-specific OIDC login action here"
answer.verification: The job has the token permission needed to request an OIDC token and is associated with the staging environment. Provider login is intentionally not fabricated.
